About NKCES

Engineering discipline, built on local trust.

North Kathmandu Construction & Engineering Services P. Ltd. (NKCES) was founded in 2018 in Tarakeshwor-6, Kathmandu, to bring dependable civil engineering and construction practice to homes, institutions and infrastructure across the region.

From foundation surveys to final handover, we pair technical rigor with plain, honest communication — so every client understands exactly what is being built, why, and to what standard.

  • Licensed engineering oversight on every project we accept
  • Transparent estimates before a single brick is laid
  • Site supervision from excavation through finishing
  • Designs suited to Kathmandu Valley's soil and seismic conditions
AB

Anil Bhatta

"We don't just hand over a structure — we hand over something a family or a community can trust for generations. That standard doesn't change, no matter the size of the project."
What We Do

Full-cycle civil & structural engineering

From first sketch to final inspection, our services cover every stage a construction or engineering project needs.

Civil Engineering

Site surveys, foundation design and infrastructure planning built for Kathmandu Valley conditions.

Structural Design

Seismic-aware structural analysis and reinforcement detailing for safe, code-compliant buildings.

Architectural Design

Functional, buildable floor plans and elevations for residential and institutional spaces.

Construction Management

End-to-end project scheduling, contractor coordination and budget control.

Land Surveying

Topographic and boundary surveys that keep every design accurate to the site.

Consultation & Feasibility

Independent feasibility studies and cost estimation before you commit to a build.

How We Work

01

Consultation

We listen to your goals, site and budget before proposing anything.

Design & Planning

Open Call

Have an engineering or construction project in mind?

NKCES is actively welcoming new residential, institutional and infrastructure projects across Kathmandu Valley and beyond. Whether you have a finished design or just a plot of land and an idea, we'll help you shape it into something buildable.

  • Free initial consultation and site assessment
  • Transparent, itemized cost estimates
  • Licensed engineering experience in local building codes
